name: LlamaFirewall
summary: Meta's open-source guardrail framework for agents that chains scanners for prompt injection, goal hijacking and insecure generated code.
description: Scanners: PromptGuard 2 (jailbreak/injection classifier), AlignmentCheck (chain-of-thought audit for goal hijacking and indirect injection), regex/custom LLM scanners, and CodeShield (Semgrep and regex rules across 8 languages). `pip install llamafirewall` (PyPI 1.0.3, May 2025; Python 3.10+); some scanners need access to gated Llama models on Hugging Face. MIT per LlamaFirewall/LICENSE.
